description: This file defines a Python class 'Kernel' that encapsulates the handling, parsing, and management of C/C++ kernel source code for AMD's MLIR-based build process. It includes methods for parsing C++ code, extracting port information, generating source code, and interfacing with build tools. The class is used within a larger framework for hardware kernel simulation, tracing, and compilation targeting AMD APUs.

classes.name: Kernel
classes.description: A class that manages C/C++ kernel source code, parsing it to identify ports and functions, and providing mechanisms to build, trace, and export the kernel for AMD hardware.

methods.description: Uses CppHeader to parse the C++ source code to identify kernel ports and functions.

methods.description: Displays the kernel C++ source code in a Jupyter notebook.

methods.name: _find_matching_brackets(self, s, start_index: int)

methods.name: None to_cpp(self)

methods.description: Validates input arguments against expected port counts and types.

methods.name: _set_arg_io_values(self, bufferargs, rtpargs)

methods.name: create_outputs(self, behavioral_n_tracing)

methods.name: build(self, debug=False)
